title: 배달 추적의 달인
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern with light chorus and reverb. A melodic bass guitar line follows the chord progression with a warm, rounded tone. Drums feature a tight, dry snare and a steady kick pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a relaxed, conversational tenor range with subtle doubling in the chorus. A second electric guitar provides occasional melodic fills and arpeggiated chords. The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of E Major. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar and the vocal melody.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with palm muting, melodic bass guitar]

[Verse 1]
[relaxed male vocals]
전광판은 흑색이라고 쓰여 있었어
핸드폰 열었다 다시 닫아버렸어
지나치는 차 소리 등 뒤로 지나가고
한 박자 늦게 머리카락을 건드렸어
[guitar fills with light reverb]
바람이 잠깐 내 쪽으로 불다가 어딘가 다른 데로 사라졌어

[Instrumental Break]
[electric guitar solo with clean tone and chorus effect]

[Verse 2]
언제 화면이 꺼졌는지도 몰랐어
